Business Unit: 
 
Cubic Defense 
 
 
 Company Details: 
 
 
When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people’s lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners. 

We have a top-tier portfolio of businesses, including Cubic Transportation Systems (CTS) and Cubic Defense (CD). Explore more on Cubic.com. 
 
 Job Details: 
 
 The Curriculum Developer / Instructional Designer designs, builds, and maintains technical training programs, instructional materials, and digital learning repositories. Working closely with engineers and subject matter experts (SMEs), this role translates complex technical information into clear, multi-format training content (instructor-led, virtual, self-paced, and blended). Additionally, the position manages Microsoft SharePoint Online sites to organize training resources, improve content discovery, and integrate Microsoft 365 and Power Platform tools.

 Curriculum Development 
 Design and develop technical curricula, courses, lesson plans, learning modules, and supporting materials.
 Work with subject matter experts to translate technical knowledge into clear, practical instructional content.
 Develop instructor-led, virtual, self-paced, and blended-learning materials.
 Create presentations, student guides, instructor guides, exercises, assessments, job aids, and reference materials.
 Maintain and revise curriculum as technologies, procedures, and organizational requirements evolve.
 Incorporate hands-on exercises, scenarios, demonstrations, and practical examples into training programs.
 Design, build, configure, and maintain Microsoft SharePoint Online sites supporting training, curriculum, and knowledge-management initiatives.
 Create organized repositories for course materials, instructor resources, technical documentation, policies, and reference content.
 Improve searchability and content discovery through effective metadata, taxonomy, naming conventions, and information architecture.
 Integrate SharePoint solutions with Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365, Forms, and Power Platform capabilities when beneficial.
 Support migration and restructuring of existing training materials into SharePoint.
 Provide basic documentation and guidance to site owners and content contributors.
 Qualifications 
 3+ years of experience in curriculum development, instructional design, technical training, SharePoint development/administration, or a related discipline.
 Hands-on experience with SharePoint Online , including modern pages, document libraries, lists, permissions, metadata, site navigation, and content management.
 Strong proficiency with Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, Teams, and SharePoint .
 Experience with Articulate 360, Storyline, Rise, Adobe Captivate, or learning management systems (LMS) is a plus.
 Strong writing, editing, organizational, and communication skills.
 Ability to work directly with engineers, technical SMEs, program managers, and other specialized personnel.
 Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects
 ‎ 
 Cubic Pay Range: 
$34.00 - $40.00 + benefits. ‎ 
 The Cubic pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law.

Employee ‎
